title: Start a Business for $0
subtitle: Everything you need to launch, brand, invoice, and run a company without SaaS bills.
steps: 1. Secure all logins and 2FA tokens inside Bitwarden before creating vendor accounts.
2. Create client invoices and track receipts using Wave's free invoicing tier.
3. Design your logo and pitch decks in Penpot (collaborative vector design).
4. Organize contracts and financial spreadsheets in LibreOffice Calc and Writer.
limitations: Wave charges standard merchant processing fees if clients pay by credit card. Nextcloud requires a home server or VPS for team file syncing.

title: Make Music & Beats for $0
subtitle: A complete digital audio workstation, virtual instruments, and mixing suite for $0.
steps: 1. Install your DAW (Ardour for Linux/Mac, Cakewalk for Windows, or LMMS cross-platform).
2. Install low-latency ASIO audio drivers (ASIO4ALL or your audio interface's driver).
3. Load Vital for bass and lead synths, and Spitfire LABS for pianos and organic instruments.
4. Record vocals and clean background hiss using Audacity's noise reduction filter.
limitations: Vital free tier comes with 75 presets (commercial use allowed). Requires 8GB+ RAM when loading multiple sample libraries.

title: Student Essentials Stack
subtitle: Research, cite, annotate, and ace your exams without paid subscriptions.
steps: 1. Capture class notes in Obsidian using two-way links [[topic]] to build a visual knowledge graph.
2. Install Zotero browser extension to capture research papers with 1-click citation generation.
3. Convert key exam concepts into Anki flashcards and review 10 minutes daily with spaced repetition.
4. Write essays in LibreOffice Writer and export to PDF with standardized bibliography.
limitations: Obsidian sync across mobile devices requires free Git plugin or iCloud/Syncthing rather than paid Obsidian Sync.

title: Build & Host a Website for $0
subtitle: Blazing-fast modern website deployed to global CDN edge servers with $0 hosting fees.
steps: 1. Scaffold a site with Astro or Hugo in VSCodium with modern responsive HTML/CSS.
2. Push your project to a free GitHub repository.
3. Connect Cloudflare Pages or GitHub Pages for unlimited static bandwidth and automatic HTTPS.
4. Plug in Decap CMS for client editing without monthly database or WordPress costs.
limitations: Custom apex domain (.com) costs $10-$12/year from a registrar (Cloudflare / Porkbun), though subdomains (*.pages.dev) are 100% free.

title: YouTube & Content Creator for $0
subtitle: 4K video editing, screen recording, podcast mixing, and thumbnail design.
steps: 1. Record 60fps gameplay or webcam with OBS Studio using hardware NVENC/Apple Silicon encoding.
2. Edit, color grade, and mix sound in DaVinci Resolve (free edition includes 95% of Studio features).
3. Design high-CTR 1280x720 thumbnails in Photopea or GIMP with glowing text and cutouts.
4. Compress master renders through HandBrake to reduce upload times without quality loss.
limitations: DaVinci Resolve Free caps renders at 4K UHD 60fps (sufficient for 99% of creators) and requires a modern GPU.
